about: The two candidates for each mode, four runs each (the first test and three repeats), judged again on one scale. Labels are random.
scale: 1 to 5: support for every claim, coverage of the items, no invented references

scores.label: J986
scores.why: Read the whole body (0-122k chars). The most detailed note, with correct pages: Löffler p.1849, 'most established' biomarkers p.1858, polysorbate 0.05% p.1859, crowding/extrusion p.1863, EoE p.1865, data availability p.1868; it also gets 8 figures, the funding grant and CCL37 right. Only slip: the IL-33 Th17-like shift is on p.1856, not p.1857.

scores.label: J562

scores.label: J563
